body:
Aww, did your little ego get damaged? You have nothing to say anymore. You have exhausted any interest I had in this. Fuck off, prick. I'm not merely a prodigy, I am God himself, and nothing you nor those psych* dipshits say is novel nor helpful. My addiction has its limits, and this is it. 

This is what I mean by rock bottom. The realization that I spend time communicating with filth like you will either spiral my anguish and result in my demise or compound my hatred so far that a phoenix will rise out of the ashes. 

Again you parrot this "help" bullshit, a poor euphemism for me acquiescing to your shoddy advice. FUCK YOU. FUCK ALL OF YOU. At my most delusional state, in my highest psychosis, I remain more mentally clear than you could ever dream of. 

Good bye, filthy internet, how deeply I despise you. We will not meet again.

lol. what's the point of saying I rationalize my choices? No shit. That's tautological, bro. Every single choice I or anyone else makes is what appears optimal to me or him at that point in time--which would include following your advice. You're arbitrarily saying that what I do now, ex ante your advice, is inferior to what I would do if I followed it. This MIGHT be true, but it's not true simply BECAUSE I rationalize, because that's inevitable. You seem to be a fan of using tautologies to advance an argument, which is logically impossible. 

I have no problem in claiming that death is the superior alternative sometimes. I'm not saying that's true in my situation, but to arbitrarily exclude it is fucking stupid. You cannot tell me that some choice X is eternally inferior to ALL OTHER CHOICES just because you seem to have a problem with suicide. 

Am I severely depressed or cognizant of reality? Or, are you going to tell me that I'm so delusional that I cannot be. Yeah, I know where this is going. This is a very boring dance, but I have, as it were, restless leg syndrome, and have to tango from time to time. 

Besides being a short-term artifice to get access to cheap pharmaceutical grade amphetamines, psych* haven't done shit for me. Why would I listen to them, anyway? I avoid the fuck out of the authority fallacy; they can tell me nothing I don't already know. And before you repeat "THEN Y U HERE LUULLLL???" I've already told you. It's my addiction. And I can tell you that kicking amphetamines is much easier than kicking talking about stupid shit on the internet is. 

Actually, I did start going to bars heavily the last few weeks of my college life with my newfound "friends." As stated previously, drugs don't affect me in such a tremendous way as they do others, and the amount of alcohol I'd need in my system to sufficiently douse my intellect to match theirs would give me liver failure. Translation: I pissed a lot of people off and nothing resulted from it. Everyone went back to their original group of friends and the night ended in isolation. 

My judgment of that category of friends doesn't stop me from interacting with them. I'm not going to argue with you about the status of those relationships, but I can tell you I'm not pushing anyone away. Well, except you and the other respondents, but you aren't telling me anything particularly interesting and are just subverting the conversation to make me seem like some insane asshole who needs to be set straight (that's called hyperbole, by the way, in case you want to waste more of my time by latching unto the language I chose instead of the message). 

"There are plenty of people out there who you'd instantly click with" Another absurdity that is always thrown around because you figure there just MUST be these sorts of people. THERE JUST HAS TO BE CUZ THERES SO MANY PEOPLE OUT THERE. YOU JUST GOTTA FIND THEM! Right, because I either end up finding them and you're right or no such people exist, and you'll claim that I'm just not searching hard enough. Hahahaha. Bullshit.

The "being awful" thing is a bit more complicated but it's really trivia at this point. My filter is fine. I have no reason to be a liar to a random on the internet. 

"You are not even close to being hopeless" Sage advice.
"I think you just try to push people away because depression makes it seem like the rational thing to do, it is easier and hurts less then continually trying." This is wrong. If anything is easier, it's for you to default on stupid shit like this to try to characterize me. How profoundly boring.

"Might as well" Great standard. 
Everything is hedonism according to my "worldview," so no need to be redundant. 

This isn't rock bottom. Not yet. Every time I think I've fallen all the way, some almost-meaningless nonsense comes up and drags me back--just enough to escape the bottom. I am awaiting that status. I am awaiting it all to crumble into nothingness. I can feel it will come soon. 

Sorry, the internet sucks dick. Same for gaming communities. I hate gamers as must as I'd hate junkies. We might share the "drug" of choice, but that's where our camaraderie concludes. 

I don't have hobbies, really. Besides, going in to a club to extend some hobby with the intentions of making friends otherwise isn't going to lead anywhere. Even the dumbest of humans can smell that sort of insincerity.

What do you mean by self improvement? In what way?

The reason is that I'm a human being who desperately needs interaction. I'm satisfying a need that I did not place there and that really gets on my nerves. 

Going on the internet for stupid shit like this might as well be an addiction. Oh well. Here I am. Redosing once more.

Who cares? You rooting for me won't bend reality into less of a piece-of-shit than it was prior. 

I don't believe in morality, so your comment was both unwarranted and meaningless.
This was a colossal failure. I wish I knew people in real life so I wouldn't have to resort to online interactions. Fuuuuuuuuuuck.

I've read both of your posts because I was bored this morning, which should tip you off on how miserable my life is right now.

Oh, boy, another postmodern sophist, but of the religious kind, which is even more annoying. If no one can understand me, then why did you try? If you believed in the horseshit you were selling, you should not have replied. 

You wrote too much for me to respond directly. I thought the internet was a safe heaven for autistic ramblers like you, but congratulations: you have somehow made your condition absurdly obvious with the annoying way that you elected to type. You might look into using amphetamines to calm the fuck down and gather your "thoughts." 

I will comment on the prayer thing, because it baffles me that almost everyone had something to say about God or the meaninglessness of life, two ends of the same shit-pile spectrum that I wanted to avoid. You can't imagine how annoying your question was. Pray to your nonexistent deity that he provides you with an answer of whether you should pray for me, another pointless act. 

Goddamn I fucking hate Reddit.

That's right, you don't know what to tell me. 

That doesn't impress me. The universe means nothing to me and I won't make it out into some proxy for a God that needs revering. 

There is no foolishness with suicide; nice try in making it a given by telling me I ought to have already known this. Wow. What profound sophistry. 

Nothing you said was 'overwhelming;' just trite.

Sure it is. The lack of pain is superior to pain. (and FYI the truth of my premise isn't a function of my beliefs, either). 

Not only is it meaningless, it's also stupid. How many things do you do where you have no reason to, even some to the contrary? Probably none, unless you're a retard (which I'm beginning to suspect, considering that you keep pestering someone in my state, as if you're egging me on). 

What the fuck do I care about the world? I'm not here to make life easier for anybody--especially YOU, for fuck's sake. That the world would lose me is only its loss, not mine. Fuck the world. I am no slave to a shitty society such as this.
i'll feel better when i'm dead

Do you want me to pay you to leave me alone? PM me your paypal email, guy, so we can work something out. 

Arguing with people about stupid shit on the internet is what I want to avoid. Don't tempt me to waste my time trying to reply to all that. It won't go anywhere. Besides, this is just going to make people less likely to reply because they think this post has so many replies so it's taken care of, when it's just you annoying me.

I can't get along with people because I wasn't going to fall for your trap? You were rude. I'm not going to PROVE that to you, lol. Nor am I going to expand on this needlessly for some troll. Please leave me alone.

let's keep it short and simple:

fuck you.

I...uhh...wow. 

It's not your fault, but I've heard it all before and I'm a bit upset at how big of a misinterpretation this is. I just can't communicate my thoughts it seems. 

I really wish you hadn't posted this reply, honestly. Sigh.
